change.description: Route public clipping discussion through the unified frontend-user assistant service, preserve same-target conversations across recaptures, split conversations on target changes, gate legacy installations until migration completion, and align Console/Gateway assistant lifecycle with clipping startup and shutdown.
change.release_unit_description: full-feature server and public clipping API

planned.reasoning: The approved T7 scope changes clipping discussion ownership to frontend principals, keeps legacy installations disabled until validated migration, and reuses existing assistant tables without a schema migration.

evidence.command: Defines one unified frontend-user assistant runtime, clipping target identity, migration gating, and single-worker lifecycle
Requires durable generation to remain independent of the browser connection lifecycle

current.reasoning: The HTTP chat and event routes now require a frontend session; creator/admin management remains limited to reprocess. Same-target recaptures update the unified conversation version, target changes create a new conversation, and old Pi chat state remains only for clipping processing compatibility. No production migration or deployment was performed.

scope_drift.description: The candidate is limited to clipping chat cutover, assistant storage/runtime lifecycle, migration readiness, Console startup/shutdown, and regression tests. It does not change UI routes, model providers, schema migrations, or production state.

verified.reasoning: Focused clipping, assistant, storage, migration-gate, generic API isolation, and public API tests pass; the migration journal is unchanged and valid; changed files format cleanly and the diff has no whitespace errors. Full repository check remains affected by pre-existing unrelated site diagnostics; no real model provider was called.

evidence.command: bun test src/server/clipping/api.test.ts (16 pass, 0 fail, 94 expectations)
bun test src/lib/assistant-storage.test.ts (9 pass, 0 fail; concurrent clipping first-turn deduplication covered)

public_api.legacy_behavior: Creator/admin backend sessions could reach the old clipping discussion path.
public_api.current_behavior: Clipping discussion requires the authenticated frontend principal; creator/admin authorization remains for reprocess and management operations.
public_api.migration_requirement: Old installations with legacy clipping conversation references return service unavailable until the assistant discussion migration is complete.

persistent_state.state_description: The runtime consumes existing assistant conversation, message, generation-job, and migration-state tables; no Drizzle migration or journal entry is added.
persistent_state.readable_by_prior_versions: Existing assistant tables remain readable by prior versions. Legacy clipping references require the existing migration workflow before the new clipping chat is enabled.

runtime_lifecycle.evidence: Console starts the assistant worker with clipping and stops it before clipping teardown; Gateway already uses the same assistant runtime lifecycle.
